negative_experience.text: Patient’s history of recent fever, chills, and discontinuation of revlimid due to systemic symptoms, followed by development of painful nodule and redness, supports drug-induced hypersensitivity reaction over cellulitis.

Spreading erythema and systemic symptoms (fever, night sweats) in an axillary abscess suggest Mycobacterium abscessus infection; these are key discriminative clues distinguishing it from typical cellulitis.
Patient history of recent travel and worsening symptoms after return may be a misleading clue; it does not reliably differentiate between bacterial abscesses and Mycobacterium abscessus infection.
